notes.title: New Upcoming Title and Free Old Titles
notes.content:
Hello! Time flies, and its already been over a year since I published Artifacts. I have been working on an upcoming title, and will keep working on it for quite a while (its a doozy). However, for those who enjoyed Artifacts, there are many more games that I made that are free to play now.

Itch.io is a website designed to be the easiest way for indie developers to share their projects. Before Artifacts on Steam, all of my games were only available there. They are all very unique games with the same design philosophy that went into Artifacts, so I hope that you all will enjoy them. Check out the free titles on [url=https://laber.itch.io/]https://laber.itch.io/[/url].

Anyways, it's an honor to have half a thousand people play my game. I hope you all enjoyed your stay in the kingdom of Artifacts.

notes.title: Update 2: Achievement fixes and boss buffs!
notes.content:
Hello! Thank you all for enjoying Artifacts. This update contains fixes to the steam achievements along with some slight balance changes.

Bug fix: Many achievements were bugged, either crashing the game or being impossible to unlock. These problems have been fixed, and now all achievements should be obtainable.

Minor Change: The "No Stone Unturned" achievement no longer requires all artifacts to be discovered, and now requires for almost all to be found.

Minor Change: Many late game bosses have had their health pools increased to make the fights more interesting.

Minor Change: The Sealed God boss fight now have slightly more projectiles, and has significantly more health.

Minor Change: You drop slightly less artifacts on death in hard/insane difficulties, though it is still more than in easier difficulties. This is to alleviate some frustration.

I am also keeping my eye on the "Beat the Game (40 minutes)" achievement, and will make it easier if it is not enough time.

notes.title: Update 1: Achievements and tweaks!
notes.content:
Hello! Thank you all for enjoying Artifacts so far, this launch has fortunately been very smooth! This update contains many steam achievements along with a host of small tweaks to minor mechanics.

Major Change: 45 new achievements have been added to the game! Some are hard challenges, designed to help with replayability.

Minor Change: A health cap has been added (9 hearts).

Minor Change: Pressing Q at the pause screen now exits the game, while pressing ESC unpauses.

Many other small changes (shifting signs).
